title: ze_Pirates_Port_Royal
description:
The new version of the map has its geometry completely remade from the ground up, with most settings remaining the same as in version 5_6.

A map for the Zombie Escape mod that includes 6 different levels:
4 boss fights: Cannon, Pirate, Barbossa, Kraken
6 special items: Sword, Barrel, Bubbles, Wall, Heal (4,5,6 lvl), Medallion (4,5,6 lvl)
1 zombie item: Barbossa (4,5,6 lvl)

The map doesn't work properly without the CS2Fixes plugin.
